rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a person, service, or thing that can be depended on.

example.english: That repair shop is pretty dependable; I feel at ease leaving my phone with them.
example.traditional: 呢間維修舖幾靠得住，部手機交畀佢哋整我好放心。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 wai4 sau1 pou3 gei2 kaau3 dak1 zyu6 bou6 sau2 gei1 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 dei6 zing2 ngo5 hou2 fong3 sam1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone’s actions or a plan are steady, safe, and dependable.

example.english: This arrangement is the most dependable, so we will not have to look for a car at the last minute.
example.traditional: 咁樣安排最穩陣，唔使到時先周圍搵車。
example.jyutping: gam2 joeng2 on1 paai4 zeoi3 wan2 zan6 m4 sai2 dou3 si4 sin1 zau1 wai4 wan2 ce1

rows.note: Use this mainly for a person or organization whose trustworthiness makes them dependable.

example.english: This travel agency is dependable and really trustworthy.
example.traditional: 呢間旅行社做嘢有交帶，真係信得過。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 leoi5 hang4 se5 zou6 je5 jau5 gaau1 daai3 zan1 hai6 seon3 dak1 gwo3
